verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a GPU cloud, but the evidence pack never mentions Jupyter notebooks or one-step VS Code/Cursor connection to an instance. The only access evidence is downloading a kubeconfig to use kubectl against CKS clusters, which is an adjacent cluster-access mechanism, not the named capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open Jupyter or connect my IDE (VS Code/Cursor) to the instance in one step
